title: Compound Bow: Reforged - Models
description: Resource pack for necessary models for the Compound Bow: Reforged Datapack. This is a port from the Compound Bow: Reforged Datapack released by me on planetminecraft: https://www.planetminecraft.com/data-pack/compound-bow-reforged-26-1/
body: This Resource Pack adds the necessary textures and models for the Compound Bow, Compound Arrows, Carbon Alloy, Advanced Carbon Alloy, Bow Limb, Pulley, and Riser.
